headings.usage: Use for all page titles, dashboard card titles, and marketing headers to provide a strong B2B SaaS presence.

body.usage: Clinical, highly readable data points, tables, and inputs.

visual enhancers.borders_and_radius: Subtle roundness. Use `rounded-md` (6px) or `rounded-lg` (8px). Never use overly bubbly pill shapes for structural cards. Always use `border border-slate-200` to ground the elements.
visual enhancers.shadows: Use layered ambient shadows `shadow-sm` on default cards. Use `shadow-md` on hover to create a slight lift effect.
visual enhancers.textures: Include a very subtle noise texture overlay on the login page geometric background to reduce digital flatness.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating navs, use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200`.
visual enhancers.data_visualization: Charts must avoid pure generic blue/green. Use brand primary (Indigo) and contrasting complementary tones (Teal/Emerald) for growth indicators. Use 1px strokes on chart lines.

grids.bento_dashboard: Base grid: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`. Gap: Tight (`gap-4` or `gap-6`).
grids.alignment: Items must stretch `h-full`. Every pixel utilized. No jagged bottoms.

layouts.app_shell: Left sidebar navigation (collapsible-friendly) + Top Header (`h-16`). Content area should have `p-6` or `p-8` for generous spacing.
layouts.login_page: Split screen layout: Left side login form (centered, 100vh), Right side immersive image (abstract geometric architecture) with a dark overlay and brand value proposition.
layouts.sources_tab: Split view or focused list view. A massive drag-and-drop zone (`border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-12 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors`). List of files below it.
layouts.growth_signals_tab: Bento layout. Left column (col-span-2): AI Insights & Themes. Right column (col-span-2): Auto-generated testimonial draft and 'Send to Customer' call to action.

motion.buttons: Hover states must include a slight translate (`-translate-y-[1px]`) and `shadow-md`. `transition-transform transition-shadow duration-200 ease-in-out`.
motion.cards: Subtle scale on hover (`hover:scale-[1.01]`) for interactive dashboard cards.
motion.modals: Email composer modal should slide in from bottom or fade with a subtle zoom (`opacity-0 scale-95` to `opacity-100 scale-100`).
motion.micro_interactions: Use Framer Motion or Tailwind transitions for tab switching and file upload state changes.

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds must meet APCA or WCAG AA standards. Ensure the Indigo primary button has white text (`text-white`).
accessibility.focus_states: All inputs and buttons must have `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:ring-offset-2`.
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).

media.icons_library: lucide-react (default). Use Duotone weight equivalent if possible, Regular for dense data.
media.images_usage: Use crisp, high-resolution imagery for marketing/login pages. Do not use generic vector illustrations.

3d_libraries.decision: Not required for core dashboard functionality. Use lightweight CSS animations or basic SVG/Canvas if needed for growth signal visualizations.
3d_libraries.fallback: Use Recharts for standard data visualization.

login_background.description: Geometric dome ceiling. Use this on the right side of the split-screen login page to convey structure and 'growth engine'. Add a dark or indigo gradient overlay (`bg-indigo-900/60 mix-blend-multiply`).

user_avatar_1.description: Professional smiling woman. Use for user profile avatar or placeholder testimonial author.

user_avatar_2.description: Professional man. Use for client avatar in the Sources/Growth Signals tab.

instructions_to_main_agent: Generate a functional frontend application using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components (js versions).
Implement the main views: Login, App Shell (with Sidebar and Dashboard Insights), and the internal Tabs (Sources, Growth Signals).
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is used for H1-H4 headings and 'Inter' for body via Tailwind config.
Implement the Login split screen. Left side: Form (Work Email, Password). Right side: Immersive image (login_background URL) with an overlay and the Uplaud AI branding/tagline.
App Shell: Left sidebar with links (Dashboard, Sources, Growth Signals). Top header: 'Growth Engine · PayRewards' + KPI Stat Cards.
Sources Tab: Create a drag-and-drop file upload zone for transcripts. Show a mock list of uploaded files.
Growth Signals Tab: Split bento layout showing AI generated insights on the left and a 'Draft Testimonial' card on the right.
Implement the 'Edit Draft' and 'Send to Customer' flow using a generic Modal/Dialog component for the email composer.
DO NOT use raw HTML for interactive components. Rely heavily on customized shadcn/ui wrappers.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs or overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use actual SVG icons from Phosphor or Lucide.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Add padding inside bordered containers.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. ALWAYS use actual image URLs provided in `image_urls`.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner components are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js` or `.jsx`.
